title: Wheelsets & Bearings

canonicalTerminology.definition: A wheelset is the mechanically coupled assembly of two railway wheels and an axle that guides and supports a rail vehicle.

claims.text: Wheelsets carry vehicle loads, transmit traction or braking forces where applicable, and maintain guidance through the wheel-rail interface.
claims.applicabilityNote: Educational canonical statement. Apply current controlled legislation, standards, manufacturer documentation and organisational procedures where operational decisions are involved.

equations.limitation: Kinematic teaching relationship only; actual rolling radius and wheel-rail behaviour depend on profile, wear and operating conditions.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show wheelset, axle, wheels, bearing journals and axlebox relationship.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent operational acceptance limits, tolerances, settings or manufacturer-specific values.
Do not present educational diagrams or summaries as approved operating or maintenance instructions.
